Motion to go into Closed Session

motions.item_title: Motion to go into Closed Session
motions.text: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo suspend the rules of procedure in accordance with sections 2.3 and 8.6 of the Procedural By-law, by adding an additional purpose to its Special Council agenda being held on December 11, 2025 as follows: Amending to the closed session motion under item 5 to include: Receiving information regarding potential litigation related to water quantity in the Region.
motions.text_html:
That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo suspend the rules of procedure in accordance with sections 2.3 and 8.6 of the Procedural By-law, by adding an additional purpose to its Special Council agenda being held on December 11, 2025 as follows:

  1. Amending to the closed session motion under item 5 to include: Receiving information regarding potential litigation related to water quantity in the Region.

motions.item_title: Motion to go into Closed Session
motions.text: That a closed meeting of the Council be held on December 11, 2025, at approximately 9:05 a.m., in the Waterloo County Room, in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters: Advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose, related to ongoing litigation regarding the 100 Victoria Street encampment; and Receiving information regarding potential litigation related to water quantity in the Region.
motions.text_html:
That a closed meeting of the Council be held on December 11, 2025, at approximately 9:05 a.m., in the Waterloo County Room, in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters:

  1. Advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose, related to ongoing litigation regarding the 100 Victoria Street encampment; and
  2. Receiving information regarding potential litigation related to water quantity in the Region.

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 9:06 a.m.
